title: Favorite tuba and snare drum players
summary: Big Eddie Jackson, Old Man Kimball, John Porter and Joe Howard on sousaphone; snare drummers Alfred Williams, Happy Goldston, and Old Man Cottrell.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
